text:
Palladium Price in 1999
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1999, the LBMA palladium price rose 32.5% between 1999-01-29 ($335) and 1999-12-30 ($444). The highest sampled price was $444 in December and the lowest was $295 in April. The mean of these observations was $358. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
